tools.name: search_lots
tools.description: Search live wholesale lots (bulk stock: clothing by the kg or piece, bales, returns, electronics and more). Returns price per unit, minimum order (moq), stock, supplier country and link.

tools.name: get_lot
tools.description: Full details of one lot: description, photos and video, grade, pieces, weight, moq, minimum spend, stock, supplier.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: What is in stock now: live lot count by category, grade and brand.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact delivered price before ordering, per supplier: goods, carriage, VAT, the 5% buyer protection fee and total, plus anything blocking the order (supplier minimum, sold out). Creates nothing.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Place the order for a human buyer and get one pay link per supplier. The buyer opens pay_url and pays by card on Stripe; agents cannot pay. Money is held until the buyer confirms the goods arrived. Unpaid orders expire after 24 hours and hold no stock. Confirm the get_quote total with the buyer firs

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order (confirmed = awaiting payment, paid, completed). Needs the order reference and the buyer email.

tools.name: request_stock
tools.description: Ask us to find stock the catalogue does not show. We contact matching wholesale suppliers and email their offers to the buyer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: request_stock · Public sink: get_order_status, request_stock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: request_stock · Public sink: get_order_status, request_stock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
